item.title: The IPO boom and the odds of making listing gains
item.description: While the broader markets have gone nowhere, the primary market (IPOs, OFS, and FPOs) is red hot. By capital raised, this year is already on track to match, if not surpass, the last two years. And there’s a big pipeline of IPOs coming up. Even at Zerodha, there’s been a big spike in IPO applications, including people opening accounts just to apply. If you’re hoping to make easy money from IPOs, the second chart should give you some sense of the odds.

item.title: Congrats to the Groww team on the IPO
item.description: Congrats on the IPO Lalit Keshre & team, and best of luck. Btw, about 20% of all Groww IPO applications are from Zerodha customers. 😛
